meta.name: programmatic-seo
meta.description: Use when planning many similar pages from a template and a data set: choosing the pattern, deciding whether the data can carry it, and avoiding the thin-content failure that gets page sets deindexed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划批量相似页面的生成模式，避免内容过薄被降权
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用相同模板批量生成大量页面并保证它们在搜索中不被惩罚
copy.tagline_en: Plan bulk similar page patterns and avoid thin-content deindexing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate many pages from templates and keep them safe in search results

howto.what: 当你要用一套数据和模板批量生成大量相似网页时，Claude 会先判断这些数据是否足够撑起每个页面，再帮你选定合适的页面模式，并检查每个页面的标题、描述、链接等是否符合搜索引擎规则，避免整批页面因内容太薄而被搜索引擎拉黑。
howto.when: 当你打算用一套数据和模板批量规划大量相似网页时触发，例如在选模式、判断数据够不够用或怕内容太薄被搜索引擎取消索引时。

say.text: 我有一份全美城市的人口数据，想批量做城市介绍页，先帮我判断数据够不够支撑。
帮我做一个“奥斯汀最佳联合办公空间”的页面，看看用哪种模式组合。
我有一千页要一起上线，帮我检查发布前清单有没有漏项。

howto.what_en: When generating many similar pages from a template and dataset, Claude first judges if the data can support each page, helps choose the right pattern, and checks titles, descriptions, links, etc. against search-engine rules to avoid thin-content deindexing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you plan to batch-produce many similar pages from a dataset and a template, e.g. when choosing a pattern, checking if the data is enough, or fearing thin-content deindexing.

say_en.text: I have all-US city data; can it support bulk city pages?
say_en.note: Claude assesses data source and risk.

say_en.text: Help me make an 'Austin best coworking spaces' page. Which pattern combo?
say_en.note: Claude sees Curation + Locations and suggests structure.

say_en.text: I have 1,000 pages launching together. Check the pre-launch checklist.
say_en.note: Claude checks titles, links, noindex, etc.
